items.title: Brotli / Node.js Vulnerabilities
items.summary: On October 22, 2026, Open AI security researchers announced a critical severity vulnerability in Google’s Brotli decoder, identified as CVE-2026-111497.

items.title: Why U.S. Islands Are Important for Biodiversity
items.summary: Along with the more well-known islands like the Aleutian and Hawaiian Islands, the United States is home to thousands of islands found much closer to the mainland, scattered along coastlines, tucked inside estuaries, and forming barrier islands that separate coastal wetlands from the open ocean .

items.title: How to Use MPKX Files in QGIS
items.summary: With so many public agencies, particularly in the United States, relying almost exclusively on Esri’s proprietary GIS software, it’s not uncommon to find geographic data packaged or compressed in formats designed for ArcGIS.

items.title: GIS File Formats
items.summary: GIS work involves dozens of file formats. Some store geographic data, while others are created by GIS software to save a map or project.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.summary: An open-source runtime that helps operators protect running Linux systems without needing to wait for the patch or restarts OpenAI and Cisco are launching Shirudo, an open-source runtime that helps teams protect Linux systems while they roll out patches.

items.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.summary: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
items.summary: Richpanel uses GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT‑6 Luna for their conversations.

items.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
items.summary: Sergey Shirobokov, Ben Jaderberg and Ryan Babbush How using agent teams and formal verification can improve quantum algorithms for modelling fusion energy, chemistry and enzymes Quantum computers could soon solve problems beyond the reach of classical supercomputers.

items.title: A legendary philosopher isn’t buying Anthropic’s consciousness argument
items.summary: Before going public last week, Anthropic named the possibility that AI could be conscious or sentient as a risk factor for anyone investing.

items.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
items.summary: Get more helpful Search responses by securely opting in to connect Google Wallet, Drive, and the Gemini app to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode.
